entry.title: Learnings from 2026 January 3-9
entry.summary:
After my previous post from October 2025 about Learning in Public, I achieved a number of milestones that I had not posted. Brief recap to catch up to the present: participated in my first hackathon in San Francisco, building an edtech tool for homeless youth in California during Hack for Social Impact 2025
dug into some HTML tidbits I was unfamiliar with, such as fieldset and entities / character references
learned about the core logic of LLMs, thanks for renowned AI researcher Andrej Karpathy's series called Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
shipped a frontend MVP for a stealth startup in the power tech space, helping them secure their first paying customer
This week, I had a few learnings: Did you know a Promise is prioritized over setTimeout in JavaScript? It turns out the JavaScript event loop has two types of queues: macro task queue and micro task queue. Synchronous code executes first, then tasks in the micro task queue, followed at the end by tasks in the macro task queue.
I heard a software engineer speak about her focus on the "joy of experimentation," which is distinct from the results-driven development of "having to ship." I love the reminder to leave room for joy in spite of requirements and deadlines.
I started digging into how to better utilize Claude code and will begin implementing ideas from Sarah Deaton's post
To close out, I realized how I might want to use this space as not only a place to share my learnings but also as a "professional diary" of sorts. I appreciate having this space where clout and engagement are not the priority. The act of me capturing reflections is valuable enough feedback to me. Happy 2025 and onward to a great 2026.

entry.title: What is cyber security and why is it important in today’s digital world?
entry.summary: Cyber security is the practice of protecting computers, networks, systems, and data from digital attacks such as hacking, malware, phishing, and data breaches. In today’s digital world, almost everything is connected to the internet — personal data, banking, businesses, and government systems. This makes cyber security extremely important because cyber attacks can lead to financial loss, identity theft, data leaks, and even disruption of essential services. Cyber security helps by: Protecting personal and sensitive information Preventing unauthorized access to systems Ensuring safe online transactions Maintaining trust in digital platforms With the rapid growth of online services, cloud computing, and remote work, cyber threats are increasing every day. É muito comum código com vários TODO. Eles ficam perdidos em comentários, são esquecidos, e aos poucos viram dívida técnica invisível. Foi exatamente por isso que eu criei o TODO Board. Essas são pendências reais, mas elas não estão no Jira, não entram em sprint, não têm prioridade e geralmente não têm dono. Ou seja: o backlog não representa a realidade do código.
